claims.claim: The IMF says the Middle East and Central Asia economy will shrink in 2026 amid war, and Iraq, Bahrain, Kuwait and Qatar face double-digit GDP declines amid the fallout from the US-Israel war on Iran.
claims.episode_span: Iraq, Bahrain, Kuwait and Qatar face double-digit declines in GDP
claims.source_title: Middle East and Central Asia’s economy to shrink in 2026 amid war, IMF says
claims.supporting_quote: Iraq, Bahrain, Kuwait and Qatar face double-digit declines in GDP amid the fallout from the US-Israel war on Iran.

claims.claim: The IMF sharply downgraded Gulf forecasts because of the prolonged closure of the Strait of Hormuz and projects a 3.9 percent contraction in the UAE economy this year.
claims.episode_span: projects a 3.9 percent contraction in the UAE economy this year
claims.source_title: Riyadh extends airport closure, UK imposes sanctions on Iranians and IMF cuts Gulf growth forecasts
claims.supporting_quote: The International Monetary Fund sharply downgrades its Gulf economic forecasts because of the prolonged closure of the Strait of Hormuz, projecting a 3.9 per cent contraction in the UAE economy this year.

claims.claim: The IMF said an energy-supply shock linked to the Strait of Hormuz conflict pushed oil prices up 32 percent this year and global inflation to 4.7 percent.
claims.episode_span: pushed oil prices up 32 percent this year and global inflation to 4.7 percent
claims.source_title: IMF Urges Targeted Cash Transfers For Nigeria’s Poor
claims.supporting_quote: According to the Fund, a major energy supply shock linked to the conflict in the Strait of Hormuz has pushed oil prices up by 32 per cent this year, driving global inflation up to 4.7 per cent and reversing two years of progress on disinflation.

claims.claim: The IMF projected global growth of 3 percent in 2026 and 3.4 percent in 2027 if the Strait of Hormuz reopens fully by March next year.
claims.episode_span: global growth at 3 percent in 2026 and said growth could rebound to 3.4 percent in 2027
claims.source_title: IMF Urges Targeted Cash Transfers For Nigeria’s Poor
claims.supporting_quote: The Fund projected global economic growth at 3 per cent in 2026, with a call for African governments to protect vulnerable households.

claims.claim: The IMF urged targeted temporary cash transfers for Nigeria’s most vulnerable households, and Silvana Tenreyro projected Nigeria’s growth at 4.3 percent by 2027.
claims.episode_span: urged targeted, temporary cash transfers for the most vulnerable households
claims.source_title: IMF Urges Targeted Cash Transfers For Nigeria’s Poor
claims.supporting_quote: Speaking at the launch, the Economic Counselor at the Fund, Silvana Tenreyro, projected Nigeria’s growth as 4.3 per cent by 2027, outpacing advanced economies like the United Kingdom, Canada and Germany.

claims.claim: The IMF said Nigeria’s central bank should return inflation to target within two to three years and that living costs remain very high even though growth has held up for the energy exporter.
claims.episode_span: return inflation to target within two to three years
claims.source_title: IMF Urges Targeted Cash Transfers For Nigeria’s Poor
claims.supporting_quote: It must ensure that inflation returns to target within the policy horizon, which we typically consider to be two to three years.

claims.claim: Elazar Yair Wilensky, a ninth-grader, was killed in an explosion on a school trip in northern Israel, and 24 students and staff were wounded, two seriously.
claims.episode_span: Twenty-four students and staff were wounded.
claims.source_title: Teen killed in northern Israel explosion identified as Elazar Yair Wilensky
claims.supporting_quote: The ninth-grader was killed during a school trip in northern Israel; 24 students and staff were wounded, two of them seriously

claims.claim: Barbara Creecy ruled out extra government funding for South Africa’s Road Accident Fund and rejected raising the fuel levy to R3 a litre.
claims.episode_span: ruled out additional government funding for the Road Accident Fund
claims.supporting_quote: has ruled out additional government funding for the Road Accident Fund (RAF), reports EWN . Creecy also rejected its proposal to increase the fuel levy

claims.claim: The UAE Cabinet approved a Dh292.5 billion federal budget for 2027 to 2029, up 28.3 percent from the previous three-year period.
claims.episode_span: federal budget of Dh292.5 billion, about $79.64 billion, for 2027 to 2029
claims.supporting_quote: Cabinet approves a Dh292.5 billion ($$79.64 billion) federal budget for 2027 to 2029, an increase of 28.3 per cent compared with the previous three-year period.

claims.claim: Abdel Fattah al-Burhan ordered a fact-finding commission into the Jabal al-Uqaydat gold-mine strike, and death estimates were 200 from the National Umma Party and Darfur Victims Support Organization versus 72 from Emergency Lawyers.
claims.episode_span: reported 200 deaths and about 120 injuries and Emergency Lawyers reported 72 killed
claims.source_title: Sudan army chief al-Burhan orders probe into strike on mine — Asharq Al-Awsat
claims.supporting_quote: The National Umma Party and the Darfur Victims Support Organization reported 200 deaths and about 120 injuries.

claims.claim: Al-Masirah said airstrikes hit Kamaran, Qanawis and Jawf and blamed Saudi Arabia, which had not commented.
claims.episode_span: airstrikes hit Kamaran, Qanawis and Jawf and blamed Saudi Arabia
claims.source_title: Houthi rebels say multiple airstrikes targeted them in Yemen, and other Mideast developments
claims.supporting_quote: The rebel-run al-Masirah satellite television said Tuesday two airstrikes hit the Houthi-held Red Sea island of Kamaran, while a third hit Qanawis district, 55 kilometres (34 miles) northwest of the port city of Hodeida.

claims.claim: Coalition spokesman Col Turki Al Malki said two ballistic missiles launched toward Khamis Mushait were intercepted.
claims.episode_span: two ballistic missiles launched toward Khamis Mushait were intercepted
claims.source_title: Saudi Arabia vows to remain strong after deadly Houthi attacks
claims.supporting_quote: Early on Tuesday, the coalition said it intercepted and destroyed two ballistic missiles launched by the Houthis towards Khamis Mushait in the south-west of the kingdom.

claims.claim: Mr Pate said livestock uses more antibiotics than the human health sector and that resistance can move among people, animals and the environment, while Nigeria acknowledged gaps in tracking drug-resistant infections.
claims.episode_span: livestock uses more antibiotics than the human health sector
claims.source_title: AMR: Livestock uses more antibiotics than human health sector – Pate
claims.supporting_quote: Mr Pate said antimicrobial resistance could move between humans, animals and the environment, emphasising the need for collaboration across sectors.
